source_description: Verified against Prodigi's H-MUG-W 11oz mug specification and supplied artwork-positioning guide: 229 x 95 mm print area, PNG accepted, 300 DPI optimal. The production export uses the guide's measured face-centre anchors at 22.5% and 77.5% of the wrap width, with the opposite-handle line at 50%. No mockup-camera correction is applied.
